content:
**Happy-Go-Lucky** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases Luck while under the influence of alcohol.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your Luck is increased by 3 while under the influence of alcohol. | 0018E147 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your Luck is increased by 2 while under the influence of alcohol. | 0018E143 | 

Happy-Go-Lucky affects the following consumables:

This perk does not apply its bonuses retroactively, meaning the player will need to have the perk equipped before consuming the alcohol in order to gain the effects.

 While Sweetwater Special Blend is considered alcohol, it is not affected by the Happy-Go-Lucky perk. [verified]
